title: United Baptist Church prior to 1963 fire
description: Renovations to the United Baptist Church took place in 1910, and a second annex was added and dedicated on December 17, 1922. For many years, the church bell rang out an invitation to worship each Sunday until it was silenced on October 16, 1963, when a fire destroyed the church, resulting in a loss of $100,000. The bell was salvaged and now sits on the front lawn of the Baptist Church on Main Street south of the bridge.
